question: How does the Siddhānta path acknowledge the existence of Vedic ritual?
premises: Vedic ritual exists as a recognized category.
The Siddhānta path has its own ritual framework.
Acknowledgment of existence does not imply adoption in this context.
inference: Therefore, according to the Siddhānta path, Vedic ritual is acknowledged as existing.
plain_english: And there is Vedic ritual; this is acknowledged according to the path of the Siddhānta.
